name: Clearly Filtered Water Filter Pitcher
imageAlt: Illustration of a water filter pitcher
description: Clearly Filtered Water Filter Pitcher, 10 Cup BPA Free Water Filtration
features: Unmatched Contaminant Protection: Your tap water faces threats most filters never address; the Clearly Filtered pitcher is backed by NSF certification and targets 386+ contaminants at up to 99.99% removal, including fluoride, lead, PFAS/PFOA, arsenic, microplastics, chlorine, and perchlorate. Our proprietary Affinity Filtration Technology uses ionic binding to capture contaminants while preserving beneficial minerals your body needs, targeting up to 73x more contaminants than typical store-bought filters.

Family-Sized 80 Fl Oz Capacity: Stop refilling constantly; this large pitcher holds 80 fl oz (approximately 10 cups / 2.4 L), delivering enough filtered water for your entire family in a single fill. Designed to fit on standard refrigerator shelves, it features a spill-resistant water dam, a redesigned ergonomic comfort handle for confident pouring, and an easy hinge fill lid so refilling takes seconds, not effort

Premium Medical-Grade Materials: The pitcher filtering your water should be as clean as the water itself; that is why Clearly Filtered uses medical-grade Tritan plastic that is BPA-free, BPS-free, non-leaching, and free from endocrine disruptors.

Long-Lasting 100-Gallon Filter Life: Each filter handles up to 100 gallons, approximately 200 refills or roughly 4 months of daily use, so you spend less time thinking about replacements and more time drinking clean water. When it is time to swap, replacing the filter is simple and available with convenient, recurring ordering through Clearly Filtered.

Independently Tested and Fully Transparent: Independently tested by a third-party lab and NSF certified to NSF/ANSI 43 and 372. Removal rates for fluoride, lead, chlorine, heavy metals, pharmaceuticals, PFAS, phthalates, microplastics, and VOCs are all publicly available, making this the top-rated choice for health-conscious parents, wellness-focused adults, and anyone with tap water quality concerns

NSF Certified: NSF International has set the highest scientific standards for third-party quality and safety testing since 1944—before the EPA even existed. Our Filtered Water Pitcher is Certified by NSF to NSF/ANSI Standards 42 & 372 for chlorine taste and odor reduction and lead-free materials. It is also independently tested beyond certification standards by EPA-accredited laboratories.
